newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nihon Tanshi says to enter JGB brokerage business.
newsitem.headline: Nihon Tanshi says to enter JGB brokerage business.

text.p: Nihon Tanshi Co Ltd, one of Japan's major money market brokers, is planning to establish an affiliate with the aim of entering the bond brokerage business, a company official said on Monday.

The new company, Nittan Brokers' Securities Co Ltd, which is scheduled to begin operations in July, will become an intermediary for Japanese government bond (JGB) transactions and also handle derivatives products such as over-the-counter bond options, said Masato Kawamura, an adviser to Nihon Tanshi.

Kawamura, who will become president of the new company, said the need to expand operations to remain competitive and to adapt to the "Big Bang" financial market reforms are the main reasons behind the establishment of the new company.

"From the standpoint of Nihon Tanshi, we felt the need to expand our product range... We also feel that under the 'Big Bang' financial market reforms, the importance of stock and bond markets will gradually increase compared to foreign exchange and money markets," Kawamura said.
Kawamura said the new company hopes to eventually become a broker of corporate bonds as well.
Nihon Tanshi has brokered JGB repo transactions, but not the buying and selling of JGBs, since last April.

JGB repo transactions involve the borrowing and lending of JGBs with cash collateral. They were started last April as a way to borrow and lend bonds without being subject to the securities transaction tax.
